result.detail: Unlisted marketplace-distribution OAuth apps (Developer Platform 2025.2+) work for other customers but capped at 25 installs until Marketplace listing approved; cap removed on approval. Private OAuth distribution: 10 customers (100 for Solution Partners). Static-token private apps: one portal only. Per-customer private app tokens each customer makes themselves = no gate, but account-bound.
